### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Compare full reverse-mode leaf gradients with independent forward finite differences across an entire computation graph.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def autograd_l05_autodiff_gradient_check(analytic_leaf_grads: dict, numeric_leaf_grads: dict) -> dict:
    rel_errors = {}
    for k, a in analytic_leaf_grads.items():
        n = numeric_leaf_grads.get(k, 0.0)
        rel_errors[k] = round(abs(a - n) / (max(abs(a), abs(n)) + 1e-12), 6)
    max_err = max(rel_errors.values()) if rel_errors else 0.0
    return {'rel_errors': rel_errors, 'max_rel_error': round(float(max_err), 6), 'passed': bool(max_err < 1e-4)}
```
